label: FortiGate 40F
description: Fortinet FortiGate 40F - fanless desktop NGFW (1 Gbps firewall / 800 Mbps IPS): five 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports named wan, lan1, lan2, lan3 and a; lan1-lan3 are the default 'lan' hardware switch and a is the default FortiLink port. No SFP cages, no PoE, no dedicated MGMT or HA port.
notes: Fortinet's fast path page states the front panel as 'Five 10/100/1000BASE-T Copper (WAN, A, and 1-3) connected to the SOC4. A is a FortiLink interface', and its `diagnose npu np6xlite port-list` output names the five ports wan, lan1, lan2, lan3 and a at 1000M - so the spec carries those names rather than a portTemplate. The 40F series data sheet's front-panel list agrees (1x GE RJ45 WAN, 1x GE RJ45 FortiLink, 3x GE RJ45 Ethernet) and its ordering description is '5x GE RJ45 ports (including 4x Internal Ports, 1x WAN Ports)'; the spec table's PoE row is 0. No SFP: the 40F is copper-only, unlike the 60F/80F desktop models.
